## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation this proposal would solve.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior or capability you would like to add.

## Architectural impact

- DAG authoring;
- runtime behavior;
- integrations;
- configuration;
- dependencies;
- scaffolding;
- backwards compatibility.

## Additional context

Add examples, references, diagrams, or other relevant information.
